name: Oguchi (Aichi, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Oguchi town emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised device with a pointed base.
history: Municipal flag of Oguchi, a town in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 April 2002; the emblem dates from 1 August 1972.

features.role: Oguchi town emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised device with a pointed base
